## Gleeson / Moloney Family — Croom SRD, Co. Limerick

## #1 ✅ 1901 Census: Stephen Gleeson — Complete Household

**Record:** House 3, Boherygeela East, DED Crean, Co. Limerick, 1901
**Source:** nationalarchives.ie Census Search (record id 6911950)

| Name | Age | Relation | Occupation | Marital Status |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| **Stephen Gleeson** | 62 | Head | Farmer | Married |
| **Mary Gleeson** | 58 | Wife | Farmer | Married |
| Stephen Jr | 34 | Son | Farms Son | Not Married |
| Hanoria | 32 | Daughter | Farms Daughter | Not Married |
| Kate | 30 | Daughter | Farms Daughter | Not Married |
| Jeremiah | 28 | Son | Farms Son | Not Married |
| Timothy | 26 | Son | Farms Son | Not Married |
| Anne | 20 | Daughter | Farms Daughter | Not Married |
| Bridget Rahelly | 19 | Servant | Gen. Servant | — |

**Key findings:**
- Wife's name is **Mary** (born ~1843), alive in 1901.
- Six children in household 1901: Stephen Jr, Hanoria/Nora, Kate, Jeremiah, Timothy, Anne.
- Jeremiah (age 28 in 1901, age ~34 at Stephen's 1907 death) — consistent with being informant on death cert.
- Bohergeela indexes as two townlands — East (Stephen) and West (Timothy) — both in DED **Crean**, NOT Meanus. Future searches must use DED = Crean.

## #2 ✅ 1901 Census: Timothy Gleeson — Complete Household

**Record:** House 1, Boherygeela West, DED Crean, Co. Limerick, 1901
**Source:** nationalarchives.ie Census Search (record id 6911709)

| Name | Age | Relation | Occupation |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Timothy Gleeson** | 64 | Head | Farmer |
| **Mary Anne Gleeson** | 60 | Wife | Farmer |
| Kathleen | 35 | Daughter | Farmer's Daughter |
| Stephen J | 30 | Son | Farmer's Son |
| Helena | 20 | Daughter | Farmer's Daughter |
| James O Brien | 70 | Visitor | Retired Farmer |
| Hanna Colman | 22 | Servant | — |
| Jerhinah Flynn | 27 | Servant | — |

**Key findings:**
- Timothy born ~1837 (age 64 in 1901), died Oct 1905. Two years older than Stephen (~1839) — consistent with siblings.
- Wife: **Mary Anne**. Children: Kathleen, Stephen J, Helena.
- In 1911 (after Timothy's death): only **Kathleen (45)** and **Helena (30)** remain at Boherygeela, DED Crean.
- "Stephen J Gleeson, age 30, Boherygeela West" visible in the census list = Timothy's son (not a separate household).

## #4 ✅ Death Cert Index: Margaret Moloney (Ballinscola), 1906

**Source:** irishgenealogy.ie Civil Records search
**Result:** 1 match

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Name | Margaret Moloney |
| Exact Date | **09 August 1906** |
| SR District / Reg Area | **Croom** (NOT Bruff/Herbertstown) |
| Age at Death | **66** |
| Group Registration ID | 4858114 |

**Key findings:**
- Born ~1840.
- Ballinscola falls under **Croom SRD**, not Bruff — corrects the earlier assumption.
- "Dec 1906" in the will calendar = date administration was granted, four months after the actual death.
- Full image cert would confirm whether Ellen was the informant (= daughter), resolving the daughter-or-sister question.

## #5 ⚠️ Death Cert Index: Our Patrick Gleeson — Candidate Found

**Source:** irishgenealogy.ie Civil Records, search 1881–1901, Croom SRD

| Record | Year | Age at Death | Group Reg ID | Status |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Patrick Gleeson | 1896 | 9 | 4115240 | ❌ Child — not our man |
| **Patrick Gleeson** | **1897** | **60** | **4224783** | ⚠️ **Strong candidate** |

**Key findings:**
- Patrick d.1897, age 60 → born ~1837. Our Patrick baptised Hospital ~1829 → expected age ~68 in 1897. An 8-year discrepancy in recorded age is at the wide end but not unusual in 19th-c. Irish civil registration.
- No Patrick Gleeson farmer appears in Croom area in the 1901 census — consistent with pre-1901 death.
- **Next step: pull full image of cert** (Group ID 4224783) to check townland and informant's name.

## #6 ❌ 1901 Census: Margaret Gleeson (Widow), Croom — **CORRECTION: THIS IS OUR FAMILY**

> **Correction note added 2026-06-07:** The original "different family" conclusion below is **wrong**. House 36 Main Street Croom Margaret Gleeson Widow age 55 + Mary 24 + Bridget 18 **IS** our family (Patrick Sr's widow Margaret Moloney + daughters Mary #5 b. 1872 + Bridget #8 b. 1881). Locked per `research/findings/patrick-gleeson/facts.md` (31 Mar 1901 row) and memory [[gleeson_bridget_1881_civil_birth]]. The "townsman/merchant" reasoning is incorrect — Patrick was documented as **Shopkeeper** on the 1881 civil birth registration of Bridget #8. This also confirms the §5 candidate Patrick Gleeson 1897 death cert IS very likely our Patrick (daughter-Bridget informant + Croom + Married + widow Margaret matches 1901). See new [[gleeson_patrick_1897_death_candidate]] memory.

## Key Admin Notes

- **Old census URL** (census.nationalarchives.ie) is decommissioned — use **nationalarchives.ie/collections/search-the-census/** instead.
- DED for Boherygeela = **Crean** in the NAI census system.
- irishgenealogy.ie civil records search requires: (1) select "Civil Records", (2) enter name/location/year, (3) enter your name + tick the Section 61 checkbox before results appear.
- irishgenealogy.ie location autocomplete must be used — typing "Croom" and clicking the dropdown suggestion is required; the text field alone may not filter correctly.
